name: Erdae geography model

referenceDrawing.note: The owner's working mosaic of the thirteen sheets. Private; never copied or linked. A second private file, Erdae.png, is 17520 x 12720 and shares the same normalised frame.

frame.name: Game layout frame
frame.note: Primary coordinates are in the game layout (the cleaned 5120 x 2560 reference of 18 October 2026, with the widened central sea), because the working drawing is the un-rearranged mosaic: the East Lands, the Dead Lands and the Magical Lands sit in other places and at other scales there. Every feature on a registered sheet also carries `drawing`, its coordinates in the working-drawing frame (0 to 1 of 3200 x 2323), computed through the per-sheet transforms in `sheets`.

orientation.note: Erdae is flat. There is no globe, no pole and no wrap.

edges.name: The Hoarfrost Barrier
edges.policy: impassable ice cliff along x=0 where the Cold Lands run off the map; open sea columns where the Pandar and Santon seas touch the edge become impassable "edge sea". Nothing crosses to x=1.
edges.note: Vault: the far west and north of the Cold Lands extend beyond the known map, what lies beyond is not fixed. The model leaves it unfixed: a cliff.

edges.name: The Roof Cliffs and the Ashen Cliffs
edges.policy: impassable cliffs: ice over the Cold Lands, black basalt over Zol's Mistake; open sea on the north edge becomes impassable edge sea.
edges.note: The Cold Lands and Zol's Mistake both run off the north edge.

edges.name: The Burning Rim
edges.policy: impassable lava cliffs and dune walls on the East Lands' east edge; one column of impassable edge sea where water meets the edge. The east edge never touches the west edge.
edges.note: Vault: the East Lands and the South Lands run off the east and south edges.

edges.name: The Line of Sun
edges.policy: impassable cliffs on the South Lands and the Lands of the Sun; edge sea elsewhere. The drawn labels The Line of Sun and The Sky of Erdae name this edge.
edges.note: Drawn names at the bottom of the Sunhot sheet.

wrapPolicy: Provinces on x<0.004 and x>0.996 must be impassable edge provinces; no adjacency joins the west edge to the east edge. The Cold Lands west edge and the East Lands east edge are 5,000 pixels apart in the world and must stay that way.

centralSea.note: The wide central sea between the West Lands and the Middle Lands (owner: much wider than drawn). In the layout it spans about 1,400 pixels west to east and 1,100 north to south (x 0.30 to 0.52, y 0.40 to 0.80).

featureToTerrain.plains: plains (fertility field raises supply and population)
featureToTerrain.forests: forest (density dense or fungal = forest; jungle = jungle)
featureToTerrain.ranges: mountain at the spine (elevation 4 to 5), hills in the foothill ring of 2.2 half-widths (elevation 3)
featureToTerrain.deserts: desert (kind black_waste and dust_plateau paint plains or hills with a black or grey ground texture)
featureToTerrain.ice: plains in a snow climate (HOI4 has no ice terrain; snow comes from the strategic region weather); cliffs at map edges are impassable
featureToTerrain.volcanoes: mountain with a lava ground texture (elevation 5)

terrainMapping.paintOrder: ocean, lakes, plains, desert, marsh, forest, hills, mountain, then rivers, then urban; later wins
terrainMapping.provinceDensityRules: Use region density.provincesPerState as the typical state size; inside a region make provinces 40 percent smaller (more provinces per state) on features with fertility high or very high and along coasts and the Great Lake shore, and 60 percent larger on wilderness (ice, black waste, dune sea, dense forest).

unplaced.name: Dardan
unplaced.reason: The vault leaves the place of Dardan open; the First Age note only proposes the southern approaches of the Middle Lands. Not placed; no feature may be named Dardan.

changesFromToday: The Great Lake becomes a real lake: about 240 by 215 pixels with four lobes and ports, instead of a 124 by 173 pixel blue patch.
The Vale of Aenor is plains and farmland, not beige desert: the dry yellow patches of the reference inside the Middle Lands are re-typed fertile plains.

The Great Wall of Aenor is a continuous mountain barrier of elevation 5 from the Organ cape to the south coast, with Lunhrim, the Kingson ring and four gates; Kingson sits in a valley ringed by mountains.
Rivers: 25 named rivers drawn from source to mouth, used as borders (Grey River, Fandan, Selenar, Aenar, Great River, Kulolo, Andos Water and others); lakes of every size are named.

Mountains and volcanoes are massive and named: the Hellfire Range with seven East Lands volcanoes, the Melty and Hardtmuth ranges, Herrodon Mountains, and the volcanoes of the Dead Lands; the map no longer wraps and has four impassable edges.

ranges.name: Great Wall of Aenor

ranges.name: Magic Mountains (wall section)
ranges.notes: East side of the Kingson ring: the westernmost ridge of the Magic Mountains, which stand along the whole Magical Lands border.

ranges.name: Gigantic Mountains
ranges.notes: West side of the Kingson ring (drawn Gigantic Mountains, a long diagonal belt); separates Kingson from Hunhun and the Great Lake plain.

ranges.name: Crown Mountains (south arc)
ranges.notes: South side of the Kingson ring: drawn Rush Mountains (superseded name; proposed player-facing name Crown Mountains, owner question 10).

ranges.name: Giant Mountains
ranges.notes: South section of the Great Wall (drawn Giant Mountains and Cursed Mountains): a long wild ridge down to the south coast. No wall masonry; the elves and dragons guard it.

ranges.name: Dragon Mountain
ranges.notes: The highest massif of the Wall belt and home of the dragons; stands at the south-east corner of the Kingson ring just east of the wall line, so that it belongs to the Magical Lands side. Not a country.

ranges.name: Hiloff Rim
ranges.notes: Coastal ridge on the west shore from Selen to Hiloron (the brown rim drawn as the Wall of Rush on the north-west coast; the vault puts the Great Wall in the east, so this is only a coastal ridge).

ranges.name: Crown Mountains (north)
ranges.notes: Drawn Rush Mountains under the Bloody Forest: foothill ridge on the Konori side of the wall.

ranges.name: Grano Mountains
ranges.notes: Grey hills between Hiloron and the Great Lake.

ranges.name: Deodolor Hills
ranges.notes: Brown ridge north of the Stone Forest.

ranges.name: The Grey Hills
ranges.notes: Brown hills of the south coast above Herez.

ranges.name: Tinta Hills
ranges.notes: Brown hills on the east end of the isle.

ranges.name: Magic Mountains (west ridge)
ranges.notes: Snow-capped parallel ridges that stand east of the wall, drawn as the white ridges of the Magic Mountains.

ranges.name: Magic Mountains (middle ridge)
ranges.notes: Middle snow ridge of the Magic Mountains.

ranges.name: Magic Mountains (south ridge)
ranges.notes: Southern ridge of the Magic Mountains beside Lake Lozo.

ranges.name: Herrodon Mountains
ranges.notes: The massive northern rim of the Magical Lands: the brown highland of Herrodon and Andos Enda against the Ocean of Zol.

ranges.name: Lustras Hills
ranges.notes: Hills south of Herrodon Mountains.

ranges.name: Nolorim Heights
ranges.notes: Proposed high crags of Nolorim: the high passes of the south frontier lie here (owner question 8: they may face the eastern approach or the road from the Dead Lands; the model faces them south and east).

ranges.name: Cursed Mountains
ranges.notes: Narrow dark ridge at the south end of the Kingson ring.

ranges.name: The Barren Crown
ranges.notes: Proposed low ridge of black rock across the Mistake. Unnamed in the vault.

ranges.name: Mirolon Mountains
ranges.notes: East-west ridge across the Mirolon peninsula.

ranges.name: Demonic Mountains
ranges.notes: Burning ridge on the west of the Dead Lands island.

ranges.name: Nether Mountains
ranges.notes: Volcanic ridge along the south-east of the Dead Lands island.

ranges.name: Nan Mountains
ranges.notes: Dark hills of Nan at the south tip of the Mirolon peninsula.

ranges.name: Melty Mountains
ranges.notes: Drawn Melty and Militiv Mountains: the long glacier-capped range on the east coast. It runs off the map edge in the north-east; massive, with meltwater valleys.

ranges.name: Woqood Alps
ranges.notes: Proposed ice-capped range along the northern snow coast (drawn Woqood is the snow country).

ranges.name: Hardtmuth Mountains
ranges.notes: Drawn Hardtmuth and the Mountains of Fire: the volcanic chain on the west coast of the southern lobe.

ranges.name: Hellfire Range
ranges.notes: Proposed name for the massif of Ergo, Avalon, Plutondo and the Pego Mountains: the greatest mountain mass of Erdae (drawn Ergo is a black volcanic block with the Red Lands and the lava ocean).

ranges.name: Pego Mountains
ranges.notes: Southern wall of the Hellfire massif; runs off the south edge.

ranges.name: Drak Mountains
ranges.notes: Brown volcanic ridge of Drak at the east edge.

ranges.name: Ernois Mountains
ranges.notes: Proposed coral-red highland east of the Hot Lake (drawn Ernois).

ranges.name: Reeto Heights
ranges.notes: Proposed black-rock mountains on the rift coast above the southern lobe (drawn as the black block west of Alerhia).

ranges.name: Noris Rise
ranges.notes: Proposed brown ridge across the Noris desert road.

ranges.name: Wide Mountains
ranges.notes: Low ridge across the north of the ring island.

ranges.name: Sun Mountains
ranges.notes: Drawn Sun Mountains.

ranges.name: Sukro Mountains
ranges.notes: Drawn Sukro Mountains (reading uncertain).

volcanoes.name: Goldoroth Volcano
volcanoes.notes: Drawn grey cone above Goldoroth; the Fire-Mountain above Cocanoor of the Dark Lands spec (flavour). Dormant smoke, no eruption yet.

volcanoes.name: Demonic Fire
volcanoes.notes: Proposed vent in the Demonic Mountains.

volcanoes.name: Nether Maw
volcanoes.notes: Proposed great vent of the Nether Mountains; the Abyss lies at the east end of the ridge.

volcanoes.name: Mount Nether
volcanoes.notes: Proposed cone on the Nether island.

volcanoes.name: Mount Ergo
volcanoes.notes: The great black volcano of the Hellfire Range (drawn Ergo). Highest cone of the east.

volcanoes.name: Mount Argon
volcanoes.notes: Drawn black name beside Ergo; reading uncertain.

volcanoes.name: Avalon Fires
volcanoes.notes: The Red Lands: a field of vents and lava flows (drawn Avalon, The Red Lands).

volcanoes.name: Plutondo Vents
volcanoes.notes: Vents on the east edge range (drawn Plutondo).

volcanoes.name: Drak Furnace
volcanoes.notes: Proposed vent of the Drak Mountains.

volcanoes.name: Pego Cones
volcanoes.notes: Proposed cones on the Pego range.

volcanoes.name: Fire Mountain
volcanoes.notes: Proposed second cone of the Hardtmuth chain.

volcanoes.name: Reeto Fire
volcanoes.notes: Proposed lava vent on the Reeto Heights spur (a red lava streak shows in the reference).

volcanoes.name: Great Volcano
volcanoes.notes: Drawn Great Volcano on the island of Hol in the Ihuy group.

volcanoes.name: Good Volcanoes
volcanoes.notes: Drawn Good Volcanoes on the north-east shore of the mainland (gentle, fertile ash).

volcanoes.name: Good Volcanoes (second cone)
volcanoes.notes: Second cone of the Good Volcanoes.

rivers.name: Fandan River
rivers.notes: Proposed. The one great river of the Cold Lands: from Yeldenne Heights through the Neridor gap to the Cold Ocean at Poloto. Frozen four months a year; the natural line between Coldor (west) and Isengard (north-east).

rivers.name: Naepu River
rivers.notes: Proposed. Runs from the Naepu ridge north-east to the Siroler coast.

rivers.name: Orewell Water
rivers.notes: Proposed. North-flowing stream of the Orewell lowland to the northern edge.

rivers.name: Kulolo River
rivers.notes: Drawn blue river between the Bolpor and Boldor ranges; ends in the Ilurdor lagoon. The natural line between Girdon and Saopon.

rivers.name: Grey River
rivers.notes: Proposed. The border river of Gunwaith and Girdon; the Grey Ford (Truce of the Grey Ford) crosses it where the Neck Road meets the Kulolo road.

rivers.name: Ronbo Water
rivers.notes: Proposed stream through the Ronbo Grasslands to the Kradlon Ocean.

rivers.name: Leren River
rivers.notes: Proposed river that drains the Evian lake to the Leren Ocean at Sonargur.

rivers.name: The Giant River
rivers.notes: Drawn blue river through the Giant Forest; runs along the south foot of the Darkness ridge into the inner sea.

rivers.name: River Aenar
rivers.notes: Proposed. The main river of the Vale: leaves the Lunhrim foothills, crosses Konori and the Vale and enters the Great Lake under the Parim bluff. The name follows Aenor and does not decide the open question of whether Aenor is named for Aen.

rivers.name: The Great River
rivers.notes: Drawn The Great River (reading uncertain): drains the Kingson Vale through the gorge in the Gigantic Mountains into the Great Lake. Kingson's lifeline and the only low pass through the ring.

rivers.name: River Selenar
rivers.notes: Proposed. Rises under the Crown Mountains and crosses the Selen glades to the Sea of Monsters; the natural line between Selen (north) and the Vale (south).

rivers.name: River Safen
rivers.notes: Proposed outflow of the Great Lake to the south coast at Safeton; the lake's port river.

rivers.name: River Hilorn
rivers.notes: Proposed short river from the Hiloron woods to the Crown Ocean.

rivers.name: Konorar
rivers.notes: Proposed. North-flowing stream from Konori to the Narrow Strait beside the Bloody Forest.

rivers.name: Elwen River
rivers.notes: Proposed. The great river of the Magical Forest: from the Magic Mountains east through the forest to the rift coast.

rivers.name: Andos Water
rivers.notes: Proposed river between Herrodon and Andos Enda: their old border (the Boundary Groves lie on it).

rivers.name: Lozo Water
rivers.notes: Proposed outflow of Lake Lozo toward the Zilin Hills and the Mirolon marsh.

rivers.name: Teste Brook
rivers.notes: Proposed short stream to the Ocean of Zol shore.

rivers.name: Furvi Run
rivers.notes: Proposed dark stream to the southern coast at Furviatlon.

rivers.name: Gondolin River
rivers.notes: Proposed. Meltwater of the Woqood snows to the Hot Lake north shore.

rivers.name: Fosoco River
rivers.notes: Proposed. West-bank feeder of the Hot Lake.

rivers.name: River Mora
rivers.notes: Proposed lake outflow south that dies in the desert (seasonal wadi).

rivers.name: Meltwater River
rivers.notes: Proposed. From the Melty glaciers to the Hot Lake east shore.

rivers.name: Noris Wadi
rivers.notes: Proposed dry river bed with oasis strings (Oasis-Keepers, proposed).

rivers.name: River Tich
rivers.notes: Drawn River Tich on Howan (reading uncertain).

rivers.name: Adel Burn
rivers.notes: Proposed stream on Adel.

rivers.name: Gil'dul Water
rivers.notes: Proposed stream on the Gil'dul isle south of Lerenwaith (placement uncertain).

rivers.name: R'en Water
rivers.notes: Proposed outflow of the Sea of R'en to the strait at R'en.

rivers.name: Dondor Water
rivers.notes: Proposed short river of Dondor to the Dark Sea.

rivers.name: Ashwater
rivers.notes: Proposed scalding stream on the grey plateau.

rivers.name: Sunwater
rivers.notes: Proposed river of the Sun Grasslands to Sun Lake.

rivers.name: River Mirolon
rivers.notes: Proposed short river through Mirolon's forest to the Dead's Sea.

lakes.name: Cold Tarn
lakes.notes: Proposed small glacial lake at the head of the Naepu River (a thin lake appears here in the reference).

lakes.name: Ergo Sea
lakes.notes: Drawn as a sea: an inland lake of the Girdon highlands, fed by the Kulolo.

lakes.name: Ilurdor Sea
lakes.notes: Drawn as a sea: a lagoon at the mouth of the Kulolo.

lakes.name: Evian Sea
lakes.notes: Drawn as a sea: the inland lake in the Wely ring.

lakes.name: Sea of R'en
lakes.notes: Drawn as a sea: the inland lake behind R'en.

lakes.name: The Great Lake
lakes.notes: Established heartland of Aenor. Four-lobed lake about 205 by 200 pixels (the reference shows only 124 by 173). It must be at least eight lake provinces and the shore of at least three coastal victory points. The Parim bluff stands on the north shore.

lakes.name: Semi Sea
lakes.notes: Small lake in the Organ foothills (drawn Semi Sea).

lakes.name: Lake Lozo
lakes.notes: Drawn Lozo: the long narrow lake that lies in the fold west of the Magical Forest, along the foot of the Giant Mountains.

lakes.name: Lake of Mirolon
lakes.notes: Drawn lake west of the Zilin Hills.

lakes.name: Hot Lake
lakes.notes: Drawn Hot Lake: the great hot inland lake of the East Lands, about 330 by 315 pixels.

forests.name: Worlond Forest
forests.notes: Dark conifer belt on the neck between the Cold Lands and the West Lands.

forests.name: The West Wood
forests.notes: The great dark forest block of the West Lands. It holds the drawn Girdon and Buldor woods and the Cologon and Swamp Forests; the drawn North Forests are its north-east lobe.

forests.name: Cologon Forest
forests.notes: Forest of the Corogon peninsula.

forests.name: Swamp Forests
forests.notes: Wet woods on the Herlitz foothills.

forests.name: Taith Forests
forests.notes: Woods of the western arc.

forests.name: Dwarc and Swy Forests
forests.notes: Woods of the north coast.

forests.name: Eagle Forest
forests.notes: Wood above the Leren Ocean.

forests.name: Dark Forests
forests.notes: Dense black forest of Dondor's north-east.

forests.name: Fonoor and Giant Forests
forests.notes: Woods between the Dondor arm and the Darkness ridge.

forests.name: Troll Forest
forests.notes: Vault: the Troll Forest is its own country. Drawn as a forest beside Bordon.

forests.name: Selen Weald
forests.notes: Proposed name for the great wood of Selen (drawn: Selen's dark green interior): the ranger country.

forests.name: Kilinti Forests
forests.notes: Forest of the ents (Kilinti); drawn Klinti Forests, spelling corrected by the owner.

forests.name: Bloody Forest
forests.notes: Vault: resists Aenor. On the north-east coast beside the Organ Mountains. Dark red-leaved wood on a bloodied hill.

forests.name: Hiloron Woods
forests.notes: Highland woods of the giants of Hiloron.

forests.name: Safeton Wood
forests.notes: Coastal wood of Safeton.

forests.name: Crown Forest
forests.notes: Drawn Rush Forest (superseded name): the aqua wood of the north coast.

forests.name: Stone Forest
forests.notes: Petrified wood north of the Great Lake.

forests.name: Kingdom Forests
forests.notes: Dense green strip at the foot of Lunhrim; the road to the Kingson Gate runs through it.

forests.name: Magical Forest
forests.notes: The oldest and most peaceful elven realm: a vast old forest, 80 percent canopy, the largest wood of Erdae.

forests.name: Living Forest
forests.notes: North-west part of the Magical Forest.

forests.name: Fallen Forest
forests.notes: North part of the Magical Forest.

forests.name: Mushroom Forest
forests.notes: Vault: home of the mycids. East coast belt of giant fungi along the rift shore. Terrain: forest with jungle-like density.

forests.name: Zilin Forests
forests.notes: Narrow wood beside the Giant Mountains.

forests.name: Forests of Darkhere
forests.notes: Dark wood south of the Kingson ring (drawn Forests of Darkhere).

forests.name: Mirolon Forests
forests.notes: Forest of Mirolon.

forests.name: Death Forest
forests.notes: Drawn Death Forest.

forests.name: Hell Forest
forests.notes: Drawn Hell Forest.

forests.name: Flaming Forests
forests.notes: Drawn Flaming Forests: a dark red-leaved wood east of the Noris Desert.

forests.name: Obmi Jungle
forests.notes: Drawn Obmi Jungle; HOI4 jungle.

forests.name: Mora Woods
forests.notes: Green woods east of the Hot Lake (drawn Mora).

forests.name: Alerhia Woods
forests.notes: Green belt of Alerhia.

forests.name: Gondolin Wood
forests.notes: Proposed name for the wood on the Gondolin coast.

forests.name: Oreton Woods
forests.notes: Drawn Oreton.

forests.name: Enhis Forest
forests.notes: Wood of the ring island.

forests.name: Light Forests of Yang
forests.notes: Light woods on Howan.

forests.name: God Forest
forests.notes: Drawn God Forest (the God Forest Keepers).

forests.name: Hot Forest
forests.notes: Drawn Hot Forest.

deserts.name: Cursed Lands
deserts.notes: Vault: resists Aenor. Grey barren badlands in the south marches; the curse of the Third Age never lifted. Terrain: barren hills (HOI4 hills, little supply).

deserts.name: Zol's Mistake
deserts.notes: Vault: the vast black northern wasteland. Barren black rock and ash; almost no population. Terrain: plains and desert with black ground texture, hills along the inner ridges.

deserts.name: Isle of Šodolôrō
deserts.notes: Vault: Šodolôrō lies within Zol's Mistake. The great black oval island in the middle of the Ocean of Zol; Šodolôro in game text.

deserts.name: Black Islands of the Ocean of Zol
deserts.notes: Vault: every black island of the Ocean of Zol is part of Zol's Mistake.

deserts.name: The Deadlands
deserts.notes: Grey dry plateau at the heart of Volgan's dominion; hot, bare, storm-scoured.

deserts.name: Noris Desert
deserts.notes: Drawn Noris Desert: the great sand and gravel plain of the East Lands (also holds the drawn Stabilo yellow). Part of the South Lands by the vault.

deserts.name: Sun Desert
deserts.notes: Drawn Sunhot Desert; the owner renamed the place labels to Sun Desert (19 October). The southern desert lobe runs off the south edge. Vault: the South Lands hold the Noris Desert and the former Sunhot Desert.

deserts.name: Plutondo Dunes
deserts.notes: Proposed name for the dunes below the east-edge range.

marshes.name: Papz Swamp
marshes.notes: Swamp on the Corogon peninsula (reading uncertain).

marshes.name: Saeton Swamp
marshes.notes: Reed swamp on the lake's south-east shore (reading uncertain).

marshes.name: The Great Swamp of Mirolon
marshes.notes: Drawn swamp east of the Mirolon forest.

marshes.name: Kulolo Fen
marshes.notes: Proposed fen where the Kulolo meets the Ilurdor lagoon.

marshes.name: Eekedor Reeds
marshes.notes: Proposed reed marsh on the south shore of Eekedor.

marshes.name: Dondor Fen
marshes.notes: Proposed fen along the Giant River's lower course.

marshes.name: Zilin Fens
marshes.notes: Proposed fens between Lake Lozo and the Lake of Mirolon.

marshes.name: Hot Lake Reeds
marshes.notes: Proposed reed beds on the Hot Lake's south shore (steaming shallows).

marshes.name: Verde Mangroves
marshes.notes: Mangrove flat on Verde (the reference shows a teal marsh patch).

ice.name: Frozen Lands of Coldor
ice.notes: Drawn name of the great white heart of the Cold Lands. Snow plain.

ice.name: North Yeti Lands
ice.notes: Drawn name of the north-east snow plain.

ice.name: The Hoarfrost Barrier
ice.notes: Proposed western edge of the map: an unbroken ice cliff 14 columns wide along x=0 where the Cold Lands run off the map. Impassable.

ice.name: The Roof Cliffs
ice.notes: Proposed northern edge of the Cold Lands: sheer ice cliffs, impassable. The edge of the known world.

ice.name: Windwaith
ice.notes: The long snow arm that reaches south-west off the Cold Lands (vault: the Windwaith arm).

ice.name: The Ashen Cliffs
ice.notes: Proposed northern edge of the Mistake: black cliffs, impassable. The map's north edge.

ice.name: Woqood
ice.notes: Drawn Woqood: the white snow country of the north coast.

ice.name: Snowfields of the Cold Lands
ice.notes: The whole inner Cold Lands lies under permanent snow, as in the reference. Named for the map; the drawn names Frozen Lands of Coldor, North Yeti Lands and Uplands of Ice lie inside it.

ice.name: Lerenwaith
ice.notes: White snow country of Lerenwaith, the western part of Lerendor's crown.

plains.name: Poloto
plains.notes: Low coastal strip on the neck; the Cold Lands' south-east port plain.

plains.name: Ronbo Grasslands
plains.notes: Drawn grassland of Hky and Kradlon.

plains.name: Gunwaith Downs
plains.notes: Proposed open farm and clan land of Gunwaith, north of the Grey River.

plains.name: Thenon
plains.notes: Olive lowland of Thenon.

plains.name: Zuman Uplands
plains.notes: Green upland of Adel's south shore.

plains.name: Eekedor Vale
plains.notes: Proposed fertile vale of Eekedor and Oirt; market towns of the commercial republic.

plains.name: The Vale of Aenor
plains.notes: Proposed name for the great central plain that the reference wrongly shows as beige desert. Deep black soil, wheat and orchards, the richest farmland in Erdae; 85 percent plains, the rest copses. This corrects the owner's "Aenor reads as a beige desert".

plains.name: Hunhun Downs
plains.notes: Rolling grass between the Great Lake and the Gigantic Mountains: the riders' country (Hunhun).

plains.name: Konori Downs
plains.notes: Ochre uplands of Konori: dry steppe on a low plateau.

plains.name: Novez Fields
plains.notes: Farms on the south-west shore of the Great Lake.

plains.name: Safeton Coast
plains.notes: Fertile southern coast and port plain.

plains.name: Kingson Vale
plains.notes: Proposed high valley floor ringed by the Gigantic Mountains, Lunhrim, the Magic Mountains and the Crown Mountains; one gorge (the Great River) leads out west and the Kingson Gate leads east.

plains.name: Ulgus Glades
plains.notes: Meadows on the Selen north coast.

plains.name: Rish
plains.notes: Green heart of Aenor Isle (drawn Rish).

plains.name: Greenland
plains.notes: Green strip beneath the Dragon Mountain on the elven side (drawn Greenland).

plains.name: Teste Vale
plains.notes: Vale of Teste and Andos Enda between the north rim and the forest.

plains.name: Delbiz Grasslands
plains.notes: Drawn Delbiz Grasslands on the rift coast.

plains.name: Mora and Ernois Coast
plains.notes: Green lowland east of the Hot Lake: the best farmland of the East Lands.

plains.name: Gondolin Coast
plains.notes: Proposed northern coastal plain; gives Gondolin a sea coast (owner question: the roster calls it a northern maritime crown).

plains.name: Sun Grasslands
plains.notes: Drawn Sunhot Grasslands; the owner renamed it Sun Grasslands (19 October).

straits.name: Coldor Channel
straits.notes: Proposed narrow water between the Coldor coast and the Yeti Lands shelf; crossable on the ice in deep winter.

straits.name: The Narrow Strait
straits.notes: Vault: the North Lands lie north of the Middle Lands across a narrow strait. Placed between R'en's south cape and the Bloody Forest cape of the Middle Lands; 40 to 60 pixels at its narrowest; the owner has not confirmed this place (short list 3), so the proposal stands.

straits.name: Mouth of the Leren Ocean
straits.notes: Proposed western mouth of the Narrow Strait toward the Crown Ocean.

straits.name: Northern Dark Strait
straits.notes: Vault: the Dark Lands and the North Lands are separated by a narrow strait. Between the Dondor arm and Lerendor; 25 to 35 pixels at its narrowest. Place not confirmed by the owner.

straits.name: Southern Dark Strait
straits.notes: Vault: the Dark Lands and the Middle Lands are separated by narrow straits. Between the Goldoroth south shore and the Middle Lands' west cape; 30 pixels at its narrowest. Place not confirmed by the owner.

straits.name: Mirolon Sound
straits.notes: Proposed water between the Mirolon peninsula and the Dead Lands: 120 pixels, stormy.

straits.name: The Rift Narrows
straits.notes: Vault: a long rift sea separates the Magical Lands from the East Lands. Narrowest crossing: about 200 pixels, between the Mushroom Forest coast and the Delbiz coast; the eastern coalition crosses here.

straits.name: North Mouth of the Rift
straits.notes: Proposed north mouth between Andos Enda and the island of Fladev.

straits.name: Corogon Narrows
straits.notes: Proposed narrow water between the Corogon and Varnondor peninsulas (about 40 pixels).

straits.name: Asgard Sound
straits.notes: Proposed sound between Aenor Isle and the Hiloron coast; 130 pixels, the shortest crossing to the isle.

straits.name: Pollos Passage
straits.notes: Proposed passage between Triton's western arc and the inner arc.

straits.name: Dark Channel
straits.notes: Proposed channel mouth into the Gulf of Darkness between Bordon and Goldoroth.

straits.name: Mirolon Neck
straits.notes: Proposed narrow inlet pinching Mirolon almost off the mainland (the reference shows a water gap here).

passes.name: The Neck Road
passes.notes: Proposed key road from Fandanar over the neck: through the Neridor Mountains by the Fandan gap and the Worlond Forest to Gunwaith.

passes.name: Neridor Gap
passes.notes: The gap in the Neridor Mountains where the Fandan River and the Neck Road pass together.

passes.name: The Grey Ford
passes.notes: Proposed ford on the Grey River between Gunwaith (north) and Girdon (south): the Truce of the Grey Ford was signed here.

passes.name: Fog Gap
passes.notes: Gap in the Fog and Eye ridge on the road from Girdon to Buldor.

passes.name: Dark Gate
passes.notes: Drawn: the Dark Gate at the foot of the Goldoroth Mountains.

passes.name: Path of Dark
passes.notes: Drawn path along the south foot of the Darkness ridge to the Dun Sea.

passes.name: Kingson Gate
passes.notes: The one pass through the Great Wall for the caravans: east out of the Kingson Vale between the Lunhrim massif and the Dragon Mountain. Kingson keeps it (vault: Kingson keeps the gate).

passes.name: Great River Gorge
passes.notes: The gorge in the Gigantic Mountains: the only low road between Kingson and the Great Lake plain.

passes.name: Organ Coast Road
passes.notes: A coastal road under the cliffs of the Organ cape; narrow, held by the Bloody Forest side.

passes.name: South Gate
passes.notes: Gate of the southern wall at the Herez road, between the Giant Mountains and the Cursed Lands.

passes.name: Lunhrim Notch
passes.notes: High notch beside Lunhrim; closed to wheels, open to rangers and dragons.

passes.name: Nolorim West Pass
passes.notes: Nolorim's high pass facing the Middle Lands/ Herez road.

passes.name: Nolorim East Pass
passes.notes: Nolorim's high pass above the Lake of Mirolon.

passes.name: The Boundary Groves
passes.notes: Groves on the Andos Water where Herrodon and Andos Enda meet (site spec).

passes.name: Mirolon Passes
passes.notes: Proposed passes where the Mirolon Mountains close the land neck from the Zilin side; the vault speaks of Mirolon's northern passes the gate Volgan must take. The sea lies between Mirolon and the Dead Lands.

passes.name: Noris Gap
passes.notes: Gap in the Noris Rise on the Salt Road.

passes.name: Hardtmuth Pass
passes.notes: Pass through the Hardtmuth chain on the Sand Road.

passes.name: Melty Pass
passes.notes: Glacier pass over the Melty Mountains to the Burning Rim edge road.

passes.name: Dondor Pass
passes.notes: Pass between the Dark Forests and the Darkness ridge.

passes.name: Isengar Pass
passes.notes: The one way into the Yeldenne valley, between the Heights and the Isengar Mountains.

sites.name: Fandanar
sites.notes: Seat of Coldor (working table, replaceable name). Placed at the drawn label.

sites.name: Castle of Yeldenne
sites.notes: Castle of Yeldenne at Mp'E, frozen north of the Cold Lands; Horos and Glo. High valley between the Yeldenne Heights and the Isengar Mountains. Placed at the drawn Mp'E label.

sites.name: Eindil's Ice
sites.notes: Proposed place where Eindil sleeps: deep in the far north-west, in ice older than Aenor (vault: far north-west; exact place proposed).

sites.name: The Landing below Mp'E
sites.notes: Proposed landfall: the head of the northern bay, nearest water to Mp'E; Eindil then crosses miles of snow alone.

sites.name: Isengard
sites.notes: Coldor's rival (working table). Drawn label.

regions.name: Aenor Isle
naturalBorders: The isle is its own border.

regions.name: Dead Lands
regions.climate: Hot, dry, storm-lashed coast; oppressive heat inland and south.
regions.season: Storm season year-round on the coasts.
regions.people: Volgan at Nafeher; Demon, Dolon, Nezer; Mirolon (free); the Nether and the Abyss.
regions.fertility: Mirolon's forest and marsh; elsewhere little.
naturalBorders: Mirolon and Volgan: Mirolon Sound.
The Dead Lands island is bounded by the Tempest Reach.

regions.name: Zol's Mistake
regions.elevation: Barren plateau 1 to 2, the Barren Crown ridge 3.
regions.climate: Cold, still, ashen; no seasons to speak of.
regions.people: Almost none; the dead roam. Furviatlon is a town.
regions.fertility: None. Settlement only at Furviatlon and the island of Šodolôrō.
naturalBorders: The Ocean of Zol is the only border; every black island belongs to the Mistake.

regions.name: North Lands
regions.elevation: Lowland 1 with a highland ring 3 to 4 round the Evian lake.
regions.climate: Cool temperate maritime; snow in Lerenwaith.
regions.people: Lerendor and Lerenwaith (one crown), Eekedor, Molot, R'en, Sensai, Mina.
regions.fertility: Eekedor Vale and the Leren shore; the Leren River valley; strait ports (Sonargur, R'en).
naturalBorders: North Lands and Middle Lands: the Narrow Strait.
North Lands and Dark Lands: the Northern Dark Strait.
Lerenwaith and Lerendor: the Loron highland.

regions.name: Dark Lands
regions.elevation: The Darkness ridge and the Goldoroth Mountains at 4 to 5; Dondor lowland 1.
regions.people: Dondor, Goldoroth, Bordon, Dreson, Dulundur, Troll Forest and orc holds.
regions.fertility: Dondor plain and the Giant River valley; little else.
naturalBorders: Dondor and Goldoroth: the Darkness ridge and the inner sea.
Goldoroth and Bordon: the Goldoroth Mountains.
Dark Lands and its neighbours: the two straits.

regions.name: Middle Lands
regions.elevation: Plains 1, Konori plateau 2, Wall belt 4 to 5 on the east.
regions.climate: Warm temperate, humid, long growing season.
regions.people: Aenor and the Concord: Selen, Kilinti, Kingson, Hiloron, Konori, Hunhun, Herez; Cursed Lands and Bloody Forest apart.
regions.fertility: Erdae's richest land: the Vale of Aenor, the Great Lake shore, Novez Fields, Safeton, Hunhun Downs.
naturalBorders: Aenor and the Magical Lands: the Great Wall.
Aenor and Selen: the River Selenar.
Aenor and Hiloron: the Grano hills and River Hilorn.
Aenor and Kingson: the Gigantic Mountains and the Great River gorge.
Aenor and Bloody Forest: the Crown Mountains (north).
Aenor and Herez and the Cursed Lands: the Grey Hills.

regions.name: Magical Lands
regions.elevation: Magic Mountains and the Wall belt 4 to 5, Herrodon Mountains 5, forest basin 2.
regions.season: Equable; enchanted warmth in the forest.
regions.people: Twenty-one elven realms: Magical Forest, Herrodon, Andos Enda, Nolorim and others; mycids; the Worshipdom in the Zilin Hills.
regions.fertility: Forest clearings, the Teste Vale, the Elwen river and the rift shore.
naturalBorders: Magical Lands and Middle Lands: the Great Wall.
Herrodon and Andos Enda: Andos Water.
The Magical Forest and the Mushroom Forest: the Elwen River.
Nolorim and the Worshipdom: the Lake of Mirolon.
Magical Lands and the East Lands: the Rift.

regions.name: Lands of the Sun
regions.elevation: Sun and Sukro Mountains 4; volcanoes 4 to 5.
regions.season: Long dry summers, short mild winters.
regions.people: Sunhot elves, Gala elves, Goodin sunfolk; many small realms.
regions.fertility: Sun Grasslands, the Good Volcanoes' ash soils, Sun Lake.
naturalBorders: The Sun Mountains and Sukro Mountains split the realms; the Sea of Gods bounds the north.

regions.name: Triton's Islands
regions.elevation: Arcs of low ridges 2 to 4 around the Pupor Ocean.
regions.climate: Maritime, windy, storm-prone (the drawn Tornado Islands).
regions.people: Island lordships: Adel, Pollos, Raerby, Nondondor; fishers, pirates, chart houses.
regions.fertility: Sheltered inner shores of the arcs.
naturalBorders: Every island is its own border; the arcs enclose the Pupor Ocean.

regions.name: Windwaith arm (Cold Lands)
naturalBorders: The arm is bounded by the Pandar sea and the Triton's Ocean; it joins the Cold Lands over the sea only by the ice in winter.

regions.name: Cold Lands
regions.elevation: Flat ice plain 1, broken by three great ranges (Icy, Isengar, Cold Mountains) at 4 to 5.
regions.climate: Arctic and subarctic; long dark winters, short cool summers; blizzards on the coasts.
regions.season: Frozen from Deepwinter to Thaw; rivers open only two months.
regions.people: Tribes, giants of Titanos, yeti, free coastal towns; Coldor in the west, Isengard in the north, Horidor in the south-east.
regions.fertility: Almost none inland. People live on the south and west coasts (Narnia, Andgas, Poloto), in the sheltered Isengar valley (Mp'E) and along the Fandan River; herding and sealing.
naturalBorders: Coldor and Isengard: the Fandan River and the Isengar Mountains.
Coldor and Horidor: the Naepu ridge and the Naepu River.
Cold Lands and West Lands: the Neridor Mountains and the Worlond Forest belt; the Neck Road is the only road.

regions.name: West Lands
regions.elevation: Lowland 1 with forested uplands 2 and three short ranges at 4 (Herlitz, Boldor, Fog).
regions.climate: Cool temperate; wet; snow only near the neck with the Cold Lands.
regions.people: Two dozen kingdoms: Gunwaith, Girdon, Kradlon, Corogon, Varnondor, Lambin, Buldor companies.
regions.fertility: The Girdon plain, the Kulolo valley, the Ronbo Grasslands and the Corogon coast; ports on the Blue Sea and the Crown Ocean.
naturalBorders: Gunwaith and Girdon: the Grey River, crossed at the Grey Ford.
Girdon and Buldor: the Fog and Eye ridge.
Girdon and Saopon: the Kulolo River.
Corogon and Varnondor: the strait of 40 pixels between their peninsulas.

regions.name: Islands of the South
regions.people: Howan, Nara, Verde, Enhis Is Rond; hospitable fisherfolk.
naturalBorders: Each island is its own border.

regions.name: South Lands
regions.elevation: Dune sea 1 to 2; the Hardtmuth foothills 3.
regions.people: Caravan peoples, oasis keepers; Miaed on the south shore.
regions.fertility: Oases and the western coast road only.
naturalBorders: The Ocean of the Sun on the west; the Hardtmuth chain on the east.

regions.name: East Lands
regions.elevation: Hot Lake basin 1; Melty, Hellfire and Hardtmuth ranges 5; volcanoes 5.
regions.climate: Arid to semi-arid; hot summers; snow on the north coast; volcanic south-east.
regions.season: Dry; monsoon rains on the Hot Lake.
regions.people: Noris, Stabilo, Gondolin, Drak, Alerhia, Miaed, Avalon, Mora, Ostoroth.
regions.fertility: The Hot Lake shore, Mora, Ernois, Delbiz Grasslands, the Gondolin coast and the caravan oases.
naturalBorders: Noris and Stabilo: the Noris Rise and the Flaming Forests.
Noris and Gondolin: the Fosoco River and the Woqood Alps.
Stabilo and Drak: the Drak Mountains.
East Lands and the Magical Lands: the Rift Sea.
